vehicles.trans: 5-speed automatic NAG1 (2008-2014) or 8-speed automatic TorqueFlite (2015-2023) or 6-speed manual (select years)
vehicles.slot: 2015+ (8-speed electronic shifter): COIN HOLDER to the RIGHT of the shifter — lift out the coin tray insert. Underneath is the emergency neutral release strap with a metal locking tab. CRITICAL: Slide the metal locking tab to the RIGHT to unlock it FIRST — pulling without unlocking bends/breaks the tab. Then pull the red/orange nylon strap straight UP until vertical — transmission releases to Neutral. The strap must be held up while pushing — it does NOT auto-latch. Pre-2015 (NAG1 5-speed): Plastic cover to the right of the shifter — pry off with flathead. Insert screwdriver into slot and push down the pink/orange button while moving shifter to N.
shift: BATTERY IS IN THE TRUNK — lift trunk floor panel to access. Jump terminals ARE available under the hood for jump starting.
RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST if battery is dead — connect jump pack to underhood terminals.
Once powered, use electronic shifter or ACC mode (press Start without brake) to shift to N normally.
2015+ (8-SPEED) WITHOUT POWER — red strap method:
Locate the small coin/cup holder BESIDE the gear selector on the center console.
Remove the cup insert. Use a small flathead to pop off the plastic access door.
CRITICAL: Release the locking clip first before pulling the strap — pulling without releasing the clip will damage the mechanism.
Pull UP firmly on the red strap to release the park lock. Vehicle will roll.
To hold in Neutral while moving: wedge the plastic access door lid under the strap lever.
PRE-2015 (NAG1 5-speed) WITHOUT POWER:
Locate the plastic cover beside the shifter. Pry off with a small flathead.
Insert screwdriver into the hole and push DOWN on the orange/pink/red button.
While holding the button, press brake and move selector to N.
Hellcat / Redeye / Demon: parking pawl is very strong — hold the release firmly and rock the car slightly if needed.
neutral: Apply parking brake firmly. Chock wheels — car WILL roll once released.
BATTERY IN TRUNK — use underhood jump terminals (passenger side fuse box area) to restore power first if possible.
2015+ 8-SPEED: Lift coin tray insert from RIGHT of shifter. Slide metal locking tab RIGHT to unlock. Pull red strap straight UP — hold it up while pushing to N.
Pre-2015 NAG1: Pry off plastic cover right of shifter. Insert screwdriver into slot, push pink/orange button down while moving to N.
RWD: flatbed preferred for long tows. Never tow by rear wheels only.
vehicles.notes: Final year of production: 2023. Last vehicle built December 22, 2023 (Demon 170). 5-speed NAG1: 2008-2014. 8-speed TorqueFlite8: 2015-2023.
vehicles.towMethod: Lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air or flatbed. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
towNotes: RWD: Lift from REAR. Rear (drive) wheels are lifted in the air. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION OPTION: If equipped with manual trans, no shift lock — depress clutch and select Neutral. No override slot needed.

knownIssues.title: Strong Parking Pawl on High-Performance Models
knownIssues.detail: Hellcat, Redeye, and Demon models have an exceptionally strong parking pawl that requires significant force on the manual override slot. Press firmly and hold for 3-5 seconds before attempting to move the shifter. Operators sometimes give up too early thinking the slot isn't working.

battery.location: TRUNK — under cargo floor in spare tire compartment. Jump posts under hood (driver side fuse box area) for remote access.
battery.jumpTerminals: Under hood — positive post at fuse box (driver side), ground to chassis bolt.
battery.warnings: Battery is in TRUNK. Use underhood jump posts for roadside jumping — trunk latch is electronic and won't open without power.

vehicles.trans: 5-speed automatic NAG1/W5A580 (2006-2014, continued in fleet/pursuit through 2020) or 8-speed automatic TorqueFlite ZF 8HP (2012-2023)
vehicles.slot: 2015-2023 (8-speed electronic shifter): COIN HOLDER to the RIGHT of the shifter on the console — lift out the coin tray insert. Underneath is the emergency neutral release strap with a metal locking tab. CRITICAL: Slide the metal locking tab to the RIGHT to unlock it FIRST before pulling. Pulling without unlocking bends/breaks the tab. Then pull the red/orange nylon strap straight UP until upright — holds transmission in Neutral. 2006-2014 (NAG1 5-speed, no electronic shifter): Plastic cover to the right of the shifter — pry off with flathead. Insert screwdriver into slot, push down the pink/orange button while moving shifter to N.
shift: BATTERY IS IN THE TRUNK — lift trunk floor panel to access. Underhood jump terminals available for jump starting.
RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST if battery is dead.
Once powered, use ACC mode (press Start without brake) then press brake and shift to N.
2015-2023 (8-SPEED) WITHOUT POWER — red strap method:
Locate the coin/cup holder BESIDE the gear selector on the center console.
Remove the cup insert. Use a small flathead to pop off the plastic access door.
CRITICAL: Release the locking clip before pulling the strap.
Pull UP on the red strap to release the park lock.
Wedge the plastic lid under the strap lever to hold in Neutral while moving.
2006-2014 (NAG1 5-speed) WITHOUT POWER:
Locate plastic cover beside the shifter. Pry off.
Insert screwdriver into hole and push DOWN on the orange/pink/red button.
While holding, press brake and move selector to N.
neutral: Apply parking brake firmly. Chock wheels — car WILL roll once released.
Battery in trunk — use underhood jump terminals to restore power first if possible.
2015-2023 8-SPEED: Lift coin tray insert from RIGHT of shifter. Slide metal locking tab RIGHT to unlock FIRST. Pull red strap straight UP and hold while shifting to N.
2006-2014 NAG1: Pry off plastic cover right of shifter. Insert screwdriver, push pink/orange button down while moving to N.
RWD: flatbed preferred. AWD (2017+ GT/GT Plus): flatbed required.
vehicles.notes: Final ICE Charger year: 2023. Production ended December 2023.
vehicles.warn: AWD — FLATBED PREFERRED. If wheel-lift must be used, dollies required on free-rolling axle.
vehicles.towMethod: RWD: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. AWD: flatbed only. AWD without flatbed: wheel-lift with dollies on opposite axle. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
towNotes: RWD: Lift from REAR. Rear (drive) wheels are lifted in the air. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.
AWD VARIANT: Use flatbed. If no flatbed, wheel-lift with dollies on free-rolling axle.
AWD available on V6/V8 non-SRT trims (SXT AWD, GT AWD, R/T AWD). Hellcat/SRT models are RWD only.

battery.location: TRUNK — under cargo floor on passenger side (right), in spare tire compartment. Jump posts under hood for remote access.
battery.jumpTerminals: Under hood — positive post at fuse box (driver/passenger side), ground to chassis.
battery.warnings: Battery is in TRUNK on passenger side. Use underhood jump posts — do NOT attempt to access trunk first with dead battery.

vehicles.slot: ELECTRIC VEHICLE — electronic push-button or rotary selector. Requires 12V auxiliary power to shift. No mechanical park override. 12V auxiliary battery under the hood. Dead 12V: connect jump pack to underhood terminals. Once powered, press brake and select N. High-voltage drive battery is SEPARATE — never touch orange HV cables.
shift: ELECTRIC VEHICLE: 12V auxiliary battery under hood — separate from HV drive battery.
Connect jump pack to 12V auxiliary terminals under hood if power is lost.
Once 12V power is restored: press brake and select N via push-button selector.
There is NO mechanical park override — 12V power is required.
NEVER touch orange HV cables or the high-voltage drive battery system.
FLATBED ONLY for towing — do not tow EVs by wheels.
neutral: FLATBED ONLY — never tow by wheels.
Restore 12V via underhood auxiliary terminals before shifting.
Once powered, select N electronically.
NEVER touch HV orange cables.
vehicles.notes: World's first all-electric muscle car. AWD standard on all trims. Two-door coupe (2024), four-door also available (2025). No RWD-only variant.
vehicles.warn: FLATBED ONLY — electric drivetrain or permanent AWD. Never tow with driven wheels on the ground.
vehicles.towMethod: FLATBED ONLY — electric drivetrain
towNotes: ELECTRIC VEHICLE: FLATBED ONLY — never tow with any driven wheels on the ground. Regenerative braking system can damage motor/inverter.
If vehicle must be moved short distance without flatbed, use dollies under ALL driven wheels.
12V battery ONLY for jumping — NEVER touch or access the high-voltage (HV) system. HV components are marked with ORANGE cables/covers.

battery.warnings: FLATBED ONLY. 12V auxiliary only — never touch HV system.

vehicles.slot: 1998-2009 (conventional floor lever): cap near console selector base — pry off, insert key/screwdriver, press down. 2011+ (rotary e-shifter): MANUAL PARK RELEASE in center console — open console, locate cover at the REAR of the console, snap it off. CRITICAL: Use a screwdriver to push the metal latch IN toward the tether strap FIRST to unlock it. While holding the latch in, simultaneously pull the tether strap UPWARD until the lever clicks into the released position. Transmission is now in Neutral. Do NOT just pull the strap without pushing the latch first.
shift: IDENTIFY YEAR FIRST.
1998-2009 (PHYSICAL LEVER): Turn ignition to ON. Locate cap near console selector base. Pry off. Insert key, press firmly. Press brake. Move selector to N.
2011+ (ROTARY E-SHIFTER): RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST. Connect jump pack — battery under hood. Once powered, press Start (no brake) to enter Run mode, press brake, rotate dial to N.
2011+ WITHOUT POWER — MANUAL PARK RELEASE:
Open the center console storage compartment lid.
Look at the REAR of the compartment for a plastic cover — pop it off.
Locate the metal latch with an attached strap.
Push the metal latch down to unlock, then pull the strap UP to release the park lock.
Vehicle will now roll. Apply parking brake and chock wheels before doing this.
Electronic TC/4WD (all years): must be in 2WD before road towing.
neutral: Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
1998-2009: key to ON, cap near selector, press brake, move to N.

2011+: Open center console, remove Manual Park Release cover at rear of console. Push metal latch toward tether strap with screwdriver to unlock. While holding latch in, pull tether strap UP until lever clicks into released position.
4WD: engage 2WD via electronic TC before towing.
vehicles.notes: NOTE: No 2010 Durango exists — discontinued after 2009, reintroduced 2011. 1st gen (1998-2003): body-on-frame, Dakota-based. 2nd gen (2004-2009): larger body-on-frame. 3rd gen (2011+): unibody, Jeep Grand Cherokee-based. 2000-2009: physical floor lever. 2011+: rotary e-shifter (see slot field).
vehicles.warn: AWD — FLATBED PREFERRED. If wheel-lift must be used, dollies required on free-rolling axle.
vehicles.towMethod: RWD: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. AWD/4WD: transfer case to 2WD or flatbed. AWD without flatbed: wheel-lift with dollies on opposite axle. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.

tc.type: Electric push-button (NV244 or NV140 depending on year)
positions: 2WD — rear wheels only — REQUIRED for road towing
4WD Auto — automatic AWD — NOT safe for towing
4WD Hi — part-time 4WD — NOT safe for dry-road towing
4WD Lo — low range — NEVER tow in this position
steps: Press the 2WD button on the transfer case control.
Safe to lift front (drive) wheels once confirmed in 2WD.
IF BATTERY IS DEAD: Jump battery first to power electronic TC, shift to 2WD, then disconnect. If unable to shift, FLATBED ONLY.

towNotes: ELECTRONIC TRANSFER CASE: Requires 12V power to shift. If battery is dead, jump the battery FIRST, then shift TC to 2WD before disconnecting.
DEAD BATTERY FALLBACK: If TC cannot be shifted to 2WD, USE FLATBED. Do NOT tow with TC in 4WD/4H/4L — will destroy transfer case and driveline.

battery.location: 1998-2009: Under hood, driver side. 2011+: Under front passenger seat (floor compartment beneath seat cushion). Jump posts under hood for both generations.

vehicles.slot: COLUMN/DASH SHIFTER — the Grand Caravan does NOT have a floor console gear selector. The automatic shifter is mounted on the steering column (or dash). BTSI is on the steering column: key to ON + brake releases shift lock normally. Dead battery: restore power via jump pack (battery under hood). Manual override: small access port at the base of the steering column (some years).
shift: Turn ignition key to ON (do not start) OR press Start button twice (no brake) for ACC/Run mode.
COLUMN/DASH SHIFTER: press the brake pedal firmly.
Move the column lever from Park to Neutral.
DEAD BATTERY: restore power via jump pack — battery under hood.
Once powered, key to ON, press brake, move column lever to N.
MANUAL OVERRIDE (if solenoid fails): locate the small access port at the base of the steering column. Insert a flathead and press the override lever to release.
NOTE: Grand Caravan uses a COLUMN/DASH-mounted shifter — there is NO floor console selector.
neutral: Apply parking brake.
Battery under hood — connect jump pack directly.
Key to ON, press brake, move column lever to N.
FWD ONLY — lift from front. Grand Caravan was never available with AWD.
vehicles.notes: Longer-wheelbase sibling to the regular Caravan. FWD only across entire production run. Column shifter standard.
vehicles.warn: Always apply parking brake and chock wheels before releasing Park on any incline.
vehicles.towMethod: Lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air, or flatbed. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
towNotes: FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.

vehicles.slot: Center console cubby bin BEHIND the shift lever — remove the rubber liner/insert from the bin. Insert screwdriver into the hole at the FRONT of the cubby bin. Push the manual override release lever FORWARD while moving selector to N.
shift: Turn ignition to ON (do not start engine).
Locate the center console cubby bin BEHIND the shift lever.
Remove the rubber mat/liner from inside the cubby bin.
Insert a small flathead screwdriver into the hole at the FRONT of the cubby bin opening.
Push the manual override release lever FORWARD (toward the front of the vehicle).
While holding the lever, move the gear selector from Park to Neutral.
Release the override. The selector is now in N.
NOTE: This is NOT a cap beside the shifter — it is accessed through the cubby bin behind the lever.
neutral: Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Battery under hood — connect jump pack directly.
Key to ON, then use cubby bin override (see shift steps) to move to N.
AWD: flatbed preferred.
vehicles.notes: FWD or AWD.
vehicles.towMethod: FWD: lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air. AWD: flatbed only. AWD without flatbed: wheel-lift with dollies on opposite axle. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
towNotes: FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.

battery.location: Driver-side front fender well — behind the splash shield in front of the driver's front wheel. Remove front driver-side wheel to access. Jump posts under hood.

vehicles.trans: 4-speed automatic 42RE/46RE (1987-2003, varies by engine) or 4-speed automatic 42RLE (2004-2011) or 5-speed automatic 545RFE (V8 models 2000+) or 5-speed manual (NV1500/NV3500) or 6-speed manual (Getrag 238, 3rd gen 2005-2011)
vehicles.slot: COLUMN SHIFT (most trims, 1987-2004): shift interlock on the STEERING COLUMN — key to ON + brake releases normally. No external cap. FLOOR SHIFT (higher trims, 2005-2011): small cap near the console selector base — pry off, insert key, press down. Check: bench seat = column shift. Bucket seats/console = floor shift.
shift: IDENTIFY SHIFTER TYPE: column (bench seat) or floor console (bucket seats).
COLUMN SHIFT: Turn ignition to ON. Press brake firmly. Move column lever to Neutral.
COLUMN SHIFT DEAD BATTERY: restore power via jump pack — battery under hood.
FLOOR SHIFT: Turn ignition to ON. Locate small cap near the console selector base. Pry off with key or flathead. Insert key into slot, press firmly. Press brake. Move selector to N.
FLOOR SHIFT DEAD BATTERY: restore power via jump pack — battery under hood.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION: depress clutch and move lever to Neutral.
4WD: transfer case must be in 2WD/2H before towing. Jump battery first if needed.
neutral: Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
If power cannot be restored, use the shift lock slot above — Cap at side of console shifter base.
TRANSFER CASE: must be shifted to 2WD/2H before towing. IF BATTERY IS DEAD: jump battery FIRST, shift TC to 2WD, then disconnect. If TC cannot be shifted: FLATBED ONLY.
vehicles.notes: 4WD: transfer case. Manual: clutch to N.
vehicles.warn: Must shift transfer case to 2H/2WD before road towing. Never tow in 4H or 4L on dry pavement — drivetrain damage.
vehicles.towMethod: RWD/2WD: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. 4WD: transfer case to 2H first. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.

tc.type: Manual floor lever or electric push-button depending on trim
positions: 2H — rear wheels only — REQUIRED for all road towing
4L — low range — NEVER tow in this position
steps: MANUAL: Stop completely. Shift TC floor lever to 2H.
ELECTRIC: Slow under 3 MPH. Press 2H. Confirm indicator.
Safe to lift rear wheels in 2H.
NEVER tow in 4H on dry pavement or in 4L.
IF BATTERY IS DEAD: Jump battery first to power electronic TC, shift to 2WD, then disconnect. If unable to shift, FLATBED ONLY.

towNotes: MANUAL TRANSFER CASE (floor lever): Vehicle must be STOPPED to shift. If lever is stiff, rock vehicle slightly in neutral while applying firm pressure.
ELECTRONIC TRANSFER CASE: Requires 12V power to shift. If battery is dead, jump the battery FIRST, then shift TC to 2WD before disconnecting.
DEAD BATTERY FALLBACK: If TC cannot be shifted to 2WD, USE FLATBED. Do NOT tow with TC in 4WD/4H/4L — will destroy transfer case and driveline.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION OPTION: If equipped with manual trans, no shift lock — depress clutch and select Neutral. No override slot needed.
4WD DOLLY FALLBACK: If transfer case CANNOT be shifted to 2WD (dead battery, mechanical failure), either use flatbed OR wheel-lift with dollies on the opposite axle.

vehicles.trans: 6-speed manual (Tremec TR-6060, all generations 1992-2017) — NO automatic option ever offered
vehicles.slot: ALL GENERATIONS MANUAL ONLY (no shift lock). The Dodge Viper is manual transmission only across all generations (Gen1 1992-2002, Gen2 2003-2006, Gen3 2008-2010, Gen4/Gen5 2013-2017). No automatic transmission option was offered in the US market. MANUAL: depress clutch fully and move gear lever to Neutral.
shift: MANUAL TRANSMISSION: depress clutch fully and move gear lever to Neutral.
No shift lock mechanism exists on any Viper generation.
Viper has no automatic transmission in the US market — shift lock procedures do not apply.
Wheel dollies recommended — very low ground clearance.
Do not tow by front wheels — drive wheels must be off the ground or flatbed required.
neutral: Depress clutch and move gear lever to Neutral.
No shift lock — no override needed.
EXTREME LOW CLEARANCE — flatbed only or front-wheel dollies minimum.
vehicles.notes: Most Vipers are manual. SRT/ACR: manual only.
vehicles.warn: EXTREMELY LOW CLEARANCE — flatbed ONLY. Side lift recommended.
vehicles.towMethod: FLATBED ONLY — extremely low clearance, side lift recommended
towNotes: RWD: Lift from REAR. Rear (drive) wheels are lifted in the air. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.
LOW CLEARANCE VEHICLE: Use flatbed. Check ground clearance before attempting any wheel-lift — front splitter/rear diffuser damage is common.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION OPTION: If equipped with manual trans, no shift lock — depress clutch and select Neutral. No override slot needed.

knownIssues.title: Extremely Low Ground Clearance — Side Lift Required
knownIssues.detail: The Viper has approximately 3.7 inches of ground clearance. Standard flatbed ramps cannot be used without damaging the front splitter and underbody. Side-lift equipment or very shallow approach ramps with extensions are required. Never winch from the front.

knownIssues.title: Gen5 (2015-2017) Had Optional 8-Speed Auto
knownIssues.detail: Gen1-4 Vipers (1992-2014) are manual only. Gen5 (2015-2017) offered an optional 8-speed automatic on some trims. All generations are RWD with extreme low clearance — flatbed only.

battery.location: Gen1 1992: center of trunk. Gen1-Gen2 (1993-2002): behind driver's side REAR wheel — remove rear wheel and splash shield to access. Gen3-Gen5 (2003-2017): under rear trunk panel — lift cargo carpet, remove cover. Jump posts on driver's side under hood for all generations.
battery.warnings: Side-lift or special ramps only. Carbon ceramic brakes on some trims — no metal chocks against rotors.

Pry off cap. Insert key and press firmly.
While holding, press brake. Move selector to Neutral.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION: depress clutch fully and move gear lever to Neutral.
neutral: Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — under the hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
If power cannot be restored: pry off small plastic cap at selector base, insert key/flathead, push button down while pressing brake and moving to N.

COLUMN SHIFT (base models): key to ON releases shift interlock on steering column. Check trim level — bucket seats = floor shift, bench seat = column shift.
shift: IDENTIFY SHIFTER TYPE: floor console (bucket seats) or column (bench seat).
FLOOR SHIFT: Turn ignition to ON. Press brake. Move floor selector to Neutral.
FLOOR SHIFT OVERRIDE: locate small cap near selector base. Pry off. Insert screwdriver into slot, push down orange/pink button. Press brake. Move to N.
COLUMN SHIFT: Turn ignition to ON. Press brake. Move column lever to Neutral.

neutral: Apply parking brake and chock wheels.

If power cannot be restored: pry off small plastic cap at selector base, insert key/flathead, press button while pressing brake and moving to N.
FWD: lift from front.

battery.location: Driver-side front fender well — behind splash shield in front of driver's front wheel. Remove air filter housing (or front wheel) to access. Jump posts labeled (+) and (-) under hood for remote access.

vehicles.slot: Column shifter — slot on STEERING COLUMN. Console shift: cap near selector base.
shift: Turn ignition to ON.
COLUMN SHIFT (most trims): slot is on the STEERING COLUMN — insert key into column slot, press firmly, press brake, move column lever to Neutral.
CONSOLE SHIFT: cap near selector base on console. Pry off. Insert key, press, press brake, move to Neutral.
MANUAL: depress clutch, move lever to Neutral.
neutral: Apply parking brake and chock wheels.

4WD: transfer case must be in 2WD before towing.
vehicles.notes: NOTE: Ram became a standalone brand in 2010. This entry covers the Dodge-badged Ram 1500 (1994-2001 BR/BE gen). For 2002+ Ram trucks see the Ram dataset.

towNotes: Column shifter on many trims — slot on steering column.
RWD: lift from rear. 4WD: TC to 2H.

vehicles.slot: Small cap near gear selector base on center console
shift: Turn ignition to ON (do not start engine).
Locate the shift lock override slot — Small cap near gear selector base on center console.
Pry off cap with ignition key or small flathead screwdriver.
Insert key or thin flathead into the slot and press firmly downward.
While holding the slot, press the brake pedal firmly.
Move the selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove tool and replace cap.
neutral: Apply parking brake.
Jump from underhood remote terminals labeled (+) and (-) — battery is in fender well.
Once powered, press brake and shift to N.
If power cannot be restored: pry off small cap at selector base, press override button while pressing brake and moving to N.
Avenger (2008-2014): same procedure. FWD only.
vehicles.notes: Stratus Coupe/Sedan: 1995-2006. Avenger (2nd gen): 2008-2014. Combined entry covers both. 2008-2014 Avenger: 4-speed or 6-speed auto. CVT was NOT offered on US Avenger.

towNotes: FWD: lift from front.
